## QuoteFlow core demonstration
Runs entirely without credentials. It normalizes a fictional cleaning quote request, validates required details, scores the lead, selects a pipeline stage, and prepares email and WhatsApp messages.

Replace the first Code node with the Webhook/Form Trigger in production, then connect Airtable, Gmail, and WhatsApp nodes after the preparation step.
